{"id":"JMAP-0x0q.47","title":"DID-bound check on the peerSigningKeys key","description":"Oracle: jmap-chat-spec 6bcd9d8 (quoted text). Mapped by wf_6712c4f8-c2b.

[did-cid] Rework verify_did_signature into a key-binding check on the peerSigningKeys key
Spec (b6028b3): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-did-00.md L215-221 @6bcd9d8: "After the request signature has verified ({{JMAP-CHAT-FED}}), the receiving server verifies a DID-form peer identity as follows: ... 2. It takes the Ed25519 public key that verified the request signature: the key in the peer domain's `peerSigningKeys` whose `kid` the signature's `keyid` names ({{JMAP-CHAT-FED}}). 3. The verification succeeds only if the `authentication` verification relationship ({{DID-CORE}}) of the resolved DID Document contains a verification method whose public key is an Ed25519 public key ({{RFC8032}}) equal, octet for octet, to that key. ... If the verification fails, including because the DID cannot be resolved ({{resolution}}), the identity binding of {{JMAP-CHAT-FED}} does not hold and the receiving server rejects the request." Also L211: "This document does not change that mechanism and defines no other."
Code: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/did_auth.rs:11-16 (module doc: 'runs the same checks against the DID's authentication keys instead of the peer domain's peerSigningKeys'); crate-jmap-chat-server/src/did_auth.rs:135-158 (verify_did_signature calls signed.verify(&authentication_keys(..), now, seen)); crate-jmap-chat-server/src/did_auth.rs:59-80 (DidAuthRejection::Signature(Rejection) / RefreshRequired(Rejection)); crate-jmap-chat-server/src/did_auth.rs:161-217 (authentication_keys/ed25519_key: reusable for the new comparison); crate-jmap-chat-server/src/lib.rs:99 (pub use verify_did_signature, DidAuthRejection, DidDocument); crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/did_auth.rs (whole file: oracles cite removed §Signature requirement steps and sign with keys present only in the DID Document)
Now: verify_did_signature runs a second RFC 9421 verification (checks 2-6, including nonce `seen`) using the DID Document's authentication keys as the key set, and matches the keyid's kid against RFC 7638 thumbprints of those keys. A request signed by a key that is in the DID Document but NOT in the peer domain's peerSigningKeys is accepted (the module doc says a caller 'that also verifies' against peer keys is optional). It takes now/seen and returns Accepted.
Change: Replace it with a post-verification binding check, e.g. `verify_did_binding(did: &Did, document: Option<DidDocument>, signing_key: &VerifyingKey) -> Result<(), DidAuthRejection>`. It must not re-verify the signature or consume the nonce (the one SignedRequest::verify against peerSigningKeys already did that). Keep the Unresolved and DocumentIdMismatch checks. Succeed iff some authentication verification method (embedded or referenced, as authentication_keys already resolves it) is an Ed25519 key whose 32 octets equal signing_key.as_bytes(). Replace the Signature(Rejection) variant with a KeyNotBound-style variant (the enum is #[non_exhaustive], but removing the variant is breaking). Rewrite the module and fn docs to L211-225, and rewrite tests/did_auth.rs against L215-221: sign with a key published in peerSigningKeys, then check present / absent / different-key-type / referenced-vs-embedded cases. Oracle keys must come from an external source (RFC 8037 A.1 is already used). Use did:key or did:plc fixtures, since did:web no longer needs this check (L223).

[chat-ext] Replace did_auth with DID-bound key check after peerSigningKeys verify
Spec (b6028b3): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-did-00.md L216-221: "After the request signature has verified ({{JMAP-CHAT-FED}}), the receiving server verifies a DID-form peer identity as follows: 1. The receiving server resolves the DID ... 2. It takes the Ed25519 public key that verified the request signature: the key in the peer domain's `peerSigningKeys` whose `kid` the signature's `keyid` names ({{JMAP-CHAT-FED}}). 3. The verification succeeds only if the `authentication` verification relationship ({{DID-CORE}}) of the resolved DID Document contains a verification method whose public key is an Ed25519 public key ({{RFC8032}}) equal, octet for octet, to that key."; L233: "If the key that verified a request signature is not in the `authentication` verification relationship of the cached DID Document ..., the server MUST resolve the DID again, bypassing its cache, before failing the verification. A server SHOULD NOT resolve one DID again for this reason more often than once every 60 seconds"; L223: "For a `did:web` peer identity, {{JMAP-CHAT-FED}} binds the identity by the domain name it encodes and does not require this verification"
Code: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/did_auth.rs:1-28 (module doc cites removed 'recommended realization' and 'refresh on signature failure'); crate-jmap-chat-server/src/did_auth.rs:52-80 DidAuthRejection (RefreshRequired on BadSignature too); crate-jmap-chat-server/src/did_auth.rs:104-158 verify_did_signature verifies the signature against DID authentication keys in place of peerSigningKeys; crate-jmap-chat-server/src/lib.rs:99 (re-export); crate-jmap-peer-auth-io/src/lib.rs:92-101 Authenticated exposes no verifying key/kid; crate-jmap-peer-auth/src/signature.rs:284-295 Accepted exposes no key/kid; crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/src/deliver.rs:195-209 authenticate() rejects IdentityBinding::NeedsDidVerification unconditionally; AGENTS.md:84; CHANGELOG.md:17
Now: verify_did_signature treats the DID Document as the key source (the kid must be a DID key's thumbprint) and is not chained after peerSigningKeys verification. It asks for a refresh on BadSignature as well as UnknownKey, with no 60 s rate limit. The federation handlers reject every host-less DID identity, so did:key and did:plc peers can never federate.
Change: Replace verify_did_signature with a check that takes the Ed25519 key that verified against peerSigningKeys, returned through Accepted/Authenticated (add the kid or verifying key). It returns bound only if the document's authentication relationship holds an equal key, and requests a refresh only when the key is absent from a cached document. Add or document the 60 s per-DID refetch limit. Add a FederationBackend or AuthenticatedPeer hook so that deliver.rs authenticate() accepts NeedsDidVerification once that check passes. Update AGENTS.md and the CHANGELOG (breaking pub API).","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-20T22:55:04.002149921Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-20T22:55:04.002149921Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"JMAP-0x0q.47","depends_on_id":"JMAP-0x0q","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-10-20T22:55:04.120254957Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"},{"issue_id":"JMAP-0x0q.47","depends_on_id":"JMAP-0x0q.49","type":"blocks","created_at":"2026-10-20T22:56:15.971856082Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
